claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature placement rule rooted on source item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current spawned-creature surface can express only a coarse range header, not nearest-valid-space placement relative to the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref summoned-creature language override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: A catalog-ref summon can identify the summoned monster, but it cannot add summon-time riders like understanding the summoner's languages.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl optional command range and fallback behavior
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item states that the elemental obeys commands and acts after the user, but does not define a command range or an uncommanded default behavior. The current surface requires both, forcing placeholders.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count
